desc:
An eBay Promoted Listings campaign setup puts your best items in front of more buyers at an ad rate your margin can afford. Ecom Swift LLC works out a safe rate, chooses the listings worth promoting and sets up campaigns in your own eBay account.

## What are eBay Promoted Listings?

Promoted Listings is eBay's advertising tool for sellers. You choose listings to promote and set an ad rate, which is a share of the sale price. When a buyer clicks a promoted listing and buys within the attribution window, eBay charges the ad fee. If no promoted sale happens, you are not charged that fee.

This pay-when-it-sells model sounds simple, but the rate you pick decides whether the ad makes money or quietly erodes it.

## Why the ad rate matters more than the campaign

A high ad rate can bring more visibility and still leave you with less profit than before. Every promoted sale carries the selling fees, the ad fee and the cost of shipping, and thin margins disappear fast. A very low rate may bring no extra visibility at all.

That is why we start with arithmetic, not settings. We work out what you can afford to pay per sale and still keep a profit you are happy with. Only then do we open the ads dashboard.

## How promotion can affect your sales

Promoted listings can appear in more places in search and on item pages, which can bring more eyes to an item. Whether that turns into sales depends on the listing itself: its title, photos, price and shipping. Promoting a weak listing buys attention for something buyers do not want.

For that reason we pick items with healthy margins, steady demand and clean listings. We cannot promise extra sales, because competition, season and price all play a part. What we can do is make sure the money you spend on ads goes to the items most likely to return it.

## What a well-run campaign includes

- A shortlist of listings chosen for margin, stock depth and demand.
- An ad rate calculated for each group of items from real costs.
- A Standard campaign, where you pick a rate and eBay places the ads.
- A manual campaign with keywords or rules, where eBay offers it and the package covers it.
- Campaign names that make later reviews easy.
- A review after the first results, with rates adjusted.
- Weak or low-margin items paused rather than left running.
- Listing fixes for promoted items, so the ad leads to a good page.
- A short setup note you can keep.

## What we do

We review your listings and calculate your costs per item. Then we choose the items that justify promotion and set the ad rate that suits each group. We create the campaign in your account and write a short note showing which items are included and why.

In the Basic package that is one Standard campaign. The Standard package adds more campaigns, a mid-sprint review and rate changes, and pauses weak items. The Premium package covers more campaigns and listings, uses rule or keyword campaigns where eBay offers them, and ends with a results report and next steps. Ad fees are paid to eBay by you.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Promote items you have in stock and can ship quickly.
- Start at a conservative rate and adjust after real data.
- Fix the title and photos before you pay to promote a listing.
- Review the results with fees counted, not just sales.
- Pause items that bring clicks but no profit.

**Avoid:**
- Promoting every listing in your shop at the same rate.
- Setting a rate based on a competitor's guess.
- Judging a campaign after only a day or two.
- Promoting items with very thin margins.
- Changing rates daily, which makes results hard to read.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller who has tried promotion before and is unsure whether it paid. It suits a shop with good listings and steady stock that wants more reach, and an owner who wants a controlled test before spending more on ads.

## What we need from you

Tell us your cost per item or your target margin, which listings you want included and what monthly spend feels comfortable. We never ask for your password. We work in the ads section of your own eBay account as a limited user, and you can review every campaign and ad rate we set.
